items.verbatim: SBIR PHASE II: SMART SHUNT TO TREAT HYDROCEPHALUS -THE BROADER IMPACT/COMMERCIAL POTENTIAL OF THIS SMALL BUSINESS INNOVATION RESEARCH (SBIR) PHASE II PROJECT IS THE DEVELOPMENT OF AN ADVANCED ELECTROMECHANICAL CEREBROSPINAL FLUID (CSF) SHUNT SYSTEM FOR THE TREATMENT AND MONITORING OF HYDROCEPHALUS.
